verdict.rationale: Runpod is documented only as a managed GPU cloud: Pods, Serverless and fully managed Instant Clusters running in Runpod's Secure Cloud or Community Cloud. Nothing in the pack describes a self-hostable or on-prem deployment of the core platform. The open-source CLI only manages Runpod-hosted resources, and Community Cloud describes outside providers supplying compute, so both are adjacent features rather than self-hosting of the product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
